march.plainEnglish: A unit can be invisible to the enemy and still relevant to the host. The server keeps its order. Skipping the order because the team cannot see the unit freezes it, then teleports it when a spotter arrives. The formation id still selects the offsets.
march.whyGame: Hidden is not frozen. The host keeps marching units the enemy has not spotted.

expansions.title: The shape
expansions.detail: The formation id picks the offsets. The graph does not invent them.

expansions.title: The spotter
expansions.detail: When vision returns, the unit is where the host moved it.

quiz.prompt: The enemy cannot see a unit and the host still has it selected. What should keep running?
choices: No march at all, until a spotter arrives
A vision write on the enemy team

quiz.prompt: You skip ReceiveOrder while Visible is false. What does a spotter see when the fog lifts?
choices: The unit pops from the last cell the fog remembered
The unit where the host has been moving it
An empty queue and a correct position
A second copy of the unit
quiz.why: The host kept the order. The client must not have dropped it.

quiz.prompt: The formation id selects offsets. What does the graph not invent?
quiz.why: The id picks a shape that already exists.

quiz.prompt: A hidden unit's order is also dropped on the host. What is lost?
choices: The march the server was supposed to keep
quiz.why: The host simulates. Vision is the enemy's problem.

quiz.prompt: Two squads are hidden and only one is selected. Who changes formation?
choices: Both squads, since they share one data asset

quiz.prompt: A unit the enemy cannot see should keep executing its order on the host.
Which pair can both be true?
choices: Not relevant, and still marching on the host
Visible to the enemy, and culled from the host
Hearing this click without being selected

quiz.prompt: Design renames the wedge to a column in the squad data. What does the order graph change?
choices: Nothing. The id now picks the new shape
quiz.why: The graph does not own the shape.

quiz.prompt: Which line still gates a hidden unit's click?
A spotter arrives and the unit teleports. What was skipped while it was hidden?
choices: The order, on the machine that should have kept marching
Painting cells, which would have been fine
quiz.why: Keep the order. Reveal only the cell.

barrage.plainEnglish: A fire mission spends a shell. It does not set Visible. A spotter's reveal lifts fog. A blind barrage that marks the cell visible gives the shooter the spotter's eyes. Shells are their own stock unless the design said ammo is the team's money.
barrage.whyGame: Spending supplies for every shell bankrupts the base, and painting the impact cell shows ground nobody spotted.

expansions.title: The shell
expansions.detail: One shell per mission, on the authority.

expansions.title: The spotter
expansions.detail: Reveal lifts fog. The gun does not.

expansions.title: A hit
expansions.detail: The impact can call AwardMedal when it destroys the marked target.

quiz.prompt: The player orders a barrage. What does the gun spend?
The mission excerpt subtracts one shell inside the authority check. What does that line spend?
choices: The base's money, if a shot were a purchase
The points total, as a penalty
quiz.why: Money is a separate call only if the design said so.

quiz.prompt: A blind barrage marks the impact cell visible. What did the gun steal?
quiz.why: Reveal lifts fog. The gun does not.

quiz.prompt: Every shell also subtracts supplies and the design never said ammo is money. What goes broke?
choices: The base, from shots that should have spent shells

quiz.prompt: The impact destroys a marked target. What may the gun call besides the shell spend?
choices: Painting the crater so the shooter can see it
quiz.why: A destroyed target can be a result. The cell is not.

quiz.prompt: A fire mission spends a shell and leaves the impact cell's visibility to the spotter.
quiz.why: A spotter reveals. A gun fires.

quiz.prompt: A shell misses the mark. What still happened, and what did not?
choices: The shell was spent, and no medal was awarded
Supplies were refunded and fog cleared
quiz.why: The spend is the shot. The medal is the mark.

quiz.prompt: There is no shell budget. What can one click do?
The design says a shell also costs money. Where does that money leave?
choices: A separate spend call with the row's cost
Inside the shell line, by also touching supplies
quiz.why: Do not fold money into the shell line.

quiz.prompt: Which event spends a shell without lifting fog?
choices: A drain on each drawn frame

cells.plainEnglish: Relevant and Visible answer different questions. Interest assigns Relevant twice a second from a trace, inside the authority check. Vision assigns Visible four times a second. One bool means culling the actor deletes it from a spotter's future vision.
cells.whyGame: A client that forces Relevant pulls cosmetics the server hid. A client that forces Visible cheats the map.

expansions.title: Interest
expansions.detail: Half a second, authority, the hit becomes Relevant.

expansions.title: Vision
expansions.detail: A quarter second, the hit becomes Visible for that team.

expansions.title: Cheats
expansions.detail: Neither bool is a client write.

quiz.prompt: What does Relevant answer?
choices: Whether this client receives the actor
Whether this team may see the cell

quiz.prompt: CheckAOI assigns Relevant from a trace. How often, and under what gate?
choices: Twice a second, on the authority
Four times a second, on every client
Only while the cell is visible

quiz.prompt: You use one bool for both questions. What does culling the actor also delete?
choices: A spotter's future chance to see it
quiz.why: Vision needs the actor to still exist for the host.

quiz.prompt: A client forces Relevant. What arrives that the server had hidden?
choices: Cosmetics that machine was not supposed to receive
quiz.why: Interest is not a client switch.

quiz.prompt: A client forces Visible. What can that player mark?
quiz.why: Vision is not a client switch either.

quiz.prompt: One bool can serve as both interest and vision.
Which timer is vision?
choices: An interest pass twice a second

quiz.prompt: A wall blocks the team and the host still simulates the unit beyond it. Which bools are those?
choices: Visible false, Relevant true on the host
The team sees it and the host also has it
The team sees it while the host has dropped it
quiz.why: The host has the actor. The team does not see the cell.

quiz.prompt: You save both bools. What is stale after units move?
choices: Cells and delivery that the passes would have recomputed
The order that was still running

quiz.prompt: Which line is interest, not vision?
choices: Relevant assigned from the half-second trace
Visible assigned from the quarter-second trace
A shell subtracted by the gun

convoy.plainEnglish: A strategy truck replicates fuel, or supplies if that is the stock, and the order id. It does not replicate each wheel transform. The simulation rebuilds the wheels from throttle and fuel. Driving does not drain supplies unless the design said the convoy spends the team's stock.
convoy.whyGame: Streaming every wheel bone wastes the match, and spending the build budget on driving bankrupts the base.

expansions.title: Fuel
expansions.detail: It can be its own number.

expansions.title: The order
expansions.detail: The order id says where the truck was told to go.

expansions.title: Wheels
expansions.detail: Rebuild them. Do not replicate the bones.

quiz.prompt: What should a strategy truck replicate?
choices: Fuel, or the named stock, and the order id

quiz.prompt: The client receives fuel and the order id. What does it rebuild locally?
choices: The wheels, from throttle and fuel

quiz.prompt: Driving drains supplies and the design never said the convoy spends that money. What was coupled?
choices: Fuel and the team's build budget
The order id and the formation id
quiz.why: Fuel can be its own number.

quiz.prompt: You replicate every wheel bone. What streams that the client could have rebuilt?
choices: Transforms, every frame the truck rolls

quiz.prompt: The truck is destroyed. What may that call, separate from fuel?
choices: A medal, if the design named that result
A vision clear of the whole map
quiz.why: Destruction can be a result. Fuel was the stock.

quiz.prompt: Each wheel transform should replicate.
quiz.why: Rebuild the wheels from throttle and fuel.

quiz.prompt: Which value tells the client where the truck was told to go?
Fuel hits zero and the axis is still pushed. What should stop the truck?
choices: Wiping the cells the team has revealed

quiz.prompt: A client writes fuel so the gauge drops early. What corrects?
choices: The gauge, when the authority value arrives

quiz.prompt: Which pair is the truck's replicated state, not its bones?
choices: A medal popup and a font
